# Decision-aware cost of the gap-resolved ISC observable (generated by decision_cost.py)

CAS(12,11), THC qubitization: 158 logical qubits, 2.97e+03 Toffolis per walk step, λ = 15.9 Ha, filter width Δ = 0.072 eV. S1 preparation 3.0e+05, H_SO encoding 4.5e+03, one QPE for E(S1) at 2 mHa 3.7e+07 Toffolis. Confidence 1 − δ = 0.95 per decision (amplitude estimation: median of 16 runs).

Reference, arXiv:2512.15889 (Orig-BDP, N = 11): ISC proxy 7.96e+07 Toffolis × 483 shots = 3.8e+10; threshold projection 2.72e+07 × 133 = 3.6e+09 Toffolis.
